title: pmoris/plasmovar pipeline parameters
description: A short variant calling pipeline for malaria molecular surveillance

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

auto_detect_lanes.description: Whether to (attempt to) automatically extract the lane ID from from the input fastq filenames when this info is missing from the samplesheet. Searches for file patterns such as `_L001_`, `_L1_`, `.L01`, `_lane1_` or `_lane-01_`.

auto_detect_flowcells.description: Whether to (attempt to) automatically extract flowcell IDs from from the input fastq files when this info is missing from the samplesheet.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

reference_fasta.description: Path to main reference genome in FASTA format.
reference_fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory*. If you don't have a bwa index available for the main parasite genome, this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_index` to save bwa index for future runs.
reference_fasta.errorMessage: Input must be a .fna or .fasta file (optionally gzipped).

reference_index.description: Optional path to directory housing BWA index files.
reference_index.help_text: Expected files are `*.{amb,.ann,.bwt,.pac,.sa}`. Files should have the same name as the main parasite reference genome FASTA.

save_index.description: Whether to save the generated bwa reference index.
save_index.help_text: Set to true to save the generated bwa index for the main parasite reference. The bwa index can be supplied to future runs via `--reference_index` to avoid unnecessary recomputation.

reference_bed.description: Optional path to a BED file containing the genomic regions to restrict variant calling to.
reference_bed.help_text: If not supplied, all chromosomes/contigs regions defined in the fasta reference will be used. These will be grouped into a manageable number of interval_lists to avoid problems with highly fragmented genomes with many short contigs.
reference_bed.errorMessage: Input must be a .bed file (optionally gzipped).

skipping_options.title: Skipping options
skipping_options.description: Disable specific steps of the pipeline.

skip_qc.help_text: If enabled, all quality control steps will be skipped.

skip_trimming.help_text: If enabled, read trimming step will be skipped.

skip_fastqscreen.help_text: If enabled, reads will not be screened against different reference genomes to assess the composition.

skip_hostremoval.help_text: If enabled, host reads will not be filtered out.

skip_alignment.help_text: If enabled, reads will not be aligned. Implies that any further downstream steps (variant calling and annotation) will be skipped as well.

skip_variantcalling.help_text: If enabled, variants will not be called. Implies that any further downstream steps (annotation) will be skipped as well.

skip_annotation.help_text: If enabled, variants will not be annotated.

only_index_reference.description: Only build reference indices and exit.
only_index_reference.help_text: If enabled, all optional steps will be skipped and only indices for reference genomes will be built.

only_hostremoval.help_text: If enabled, only quality control and host decontamination will be performed (including building of reference index if required).

only_fastqscreen.help_text: If enabled, only FastQ Screen step will be performed (including building of reference indces if required).

fastp_save_trimmed_fail.description: Save reads that fail quality filters.

fastp_adapter_fasta.description: Optional path to FASTA file containing adapter sequences for trimming.
fastp_adapter_fasta.help_text: fastp will automatically detect adapters if this is not supplied.
fastp_adapter_fasta.errorMessage: Input must be a .fna or .fasta file (optionally gzipped).

fastp_overrepresentation.description: Enable overrepresented sequence analysis (enabled by default).

fastp_trim_poly_g.help_text: Enabled by default for NextSeq/NovaSeq data. See: https://github.com/OpenGene/fastp?tab=readme-ov-file#polyg-tail-trimming

fastp_qualified_quality_phred.description: The quality value that a base is qualified. Used in conjunction with --fastp_unqualified_percent_limit. Fastp default is 15.

fastp_unqualified_percent_limit.description: How many percents of bases are allowed to be unqualified (0-100). Fastp default is 40%.

fastp_length_required.description: Reads shorter than this will be discarded.

fastp_cut_front.description: Enable cutting by quality in the front (5' end).

fastp_cut_tail.description: Enable cutting by quality in the tail (3' end).

fastp_extra_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to fastp.

fastqscreen_fastas.description: Comma separated list of file paths to reference genome fastas.

fastqscreen_save_index.description: Save FastQ Screen bwa index files and configuration file.
fastqscreen_save_index.help: Can be re-used for later pipeline runs via --fastqscreen_conf and --fastqscreen_ref_dir

fastqscreen_index_dir.description: Optional path to directory with pre-generated bwa index files for FastQ Screen.
fastqscreen_index_dir.help: The directory should contain subdirectories for each genome to screen against. The config file will be created automatically and does not need to be supplied.

host_removal_options.title: Host read removal options
host_removal_options.description: Configure human host read removal options.

hostremoval_save_index.description: Save generated host removal index files.

hostremoval_method.description: Method to use for host read removal.
hostremoval_method.help_text: Can be set to either `deacon` or `bbsplit`.

hostremoval_reference.description: Path to host reference genome FASTA for read removal.
hostremoval_reference.errorMessage: Input must be a .fna or .fasta file (optionally gzipped).

hostremoval_bbsplit_index.description: Path to BBSplit index directory for host removal.
hostremoval_bbsplit_index.help: Should be a directory containing a subdirectory named 'ref', which in turns consists of a 'genome' and an 'index' subdirectory.

hostremoval_bbsplit_reference_name.description: Reference name for BBSplit host removal.

hostremoval_bbsplit_ambiguous2.description: BBSplit ambiguous2 parameter - how to handle ambiguous reads.

hostremoval_deacon_index.description: Path to DEACON index directory for host removal.

hostremoval_deacon_diff.description: Whether to subtract the main reference genome index from the host filter index.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Configure options for bwa alignment of (processed) reads against reference genome.

save_bam_initial.description: Whether to save the initial BAM files.
save_bam_initial.help_text: These are the initial BAM files generated by BWA, prior to merging or duplicate marking.

save_bam_final.description: Whether to save the final BAM files.
save_bam_final.help_text: These are the final BAM files generated by BWA, merged by sample (across lanes and libraries) and after duplicate marking.

run_bqsr.description: Whether to run BQSR or not. Disabled by default.

bqsr_known_sites_vcf.description: VCF file with known sites to be used for BQSR.
bqsr_known_sites_vcf.errorMessage: Input must be a .vcf file (optionally gzipped).

bqsr_known_sites_tbi.description: Index file for VCF with known sites to be used for BQSR.
bqsr_known_sites_tbi.errorMessage: Input must be a .tbi file (optionally gzipped).

gatk_readgroup_options.title: GATK Read Group options
gatk_readgroup_options.description: Set attributes for the GATK Read Groups.
gatk_readgroup_options.help_text: The other fields are extracted automatically from the file name and fastq headers.

seq_center.description: Sequencing center for GATK read group CN field.

seq_platform.description: Sequencing platform for GATK read group PL field.

gatk_interval_options.title: GATK interval options
gatk_interval_options.description: Configure intervals of genomic regions for scatter/gather parallelization of GATK.

scatter_count.description: Maximum number of files into which to scatter the intervals for parallel processing.

save_interval_scatter.description: Save scattered interval lists for debugging purposes.

save_intermediate_gvcf.description: Save intermediate GVCF files from HaplotypeCaller.

save_intermediate_vcf.description: Save intermediate VCF files during variant calling.

vcf_filter_mode.help_text: Can be set to either `hard` or `vqsr`.

vcf_filter_snp_QD_filter.description: QD (Quality by Depth) filter expression for SNPs.
vcf_filter_snp_QD_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP QD metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_QD_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the QD filter.

vcf_filter_snp_QUAL_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP QUAL metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_QUAL_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the QUAL filter.

vcf_filter_snp_FS_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP FS metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_FS_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the FS filter.

vcf_filter_snp_ReadPosRankSum_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP ReadPosRankSum metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_ReadPosRankSum_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the ReadPosRankSum filter.

vcf_filter_snp_SOR_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP SOR metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_SOR_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the SOR filter.

vcf_filter_snp_MQ_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP MQ metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_MQ_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the MQ filter.

vcf_filter_snp_MQRankSum_filter.help_text: Filter expression for SNP MQRankSum metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_snp_MQRankSum_name.help_text: Name assigned to variants that fail the MQRankSum filter.

vcf_filter_indel_QD_filter.description: QD (Quality by Depth) filter expression for INDELs.
vcf_filter_indel_QD_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL QD metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_QD_name.description: Filter name for INDEL QD filter.
vcf_filter_indel_QD_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the QD filter.

vcf_filter_indel_QUAL_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL QUAL metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_QUAL_name.description: Filter name for INDEL QUAL filter.
vcf_filter_indel_QUAL_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the QUAL filter.

vcf_filter_indel_FS_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL FS metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_FS_name.description: Filter name for INDEL FS filter.
vcf_filter_indel_FS_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the FS filter.

vcf_filter_indel_ReadPosRankSum_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL ReadPosRankSum metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_ReadPosRankSum_name.description: Filter name for INDEL ReadPosRankSum filter.
vcf_filter_indel_ReadPosRankSum_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the ReadPosRankSum filter.

vcf_filter_indel_SOR_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL SOR metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_SOR_name.description: Filter name for INDEL SOR filter.
vcf_filter_indel_SOR_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the SOR filter.

vcf_filter_indel_InbreedingCoeff_filter.help_text: Filter expression for INDEL InbreedingCoeff metric during hard filtering. Set to empty string to disable this filter.

vcf_filter_indel_InbreedingCoeff_name.description: Filter name for INDEL InbreedingCoeff filter.
vcf_filter_indel_InbreedingCoeff_name.help_text: Name assigned to INDELs that fail the InbreedingCoeff filter.

vqsr_snp_resource_vcfs.description: List of VCF files to use as training resources for SNP VQSR.
vqsr_snp_resource_vcfs.help_text: Array of paths to high-confidence VCF files used for training the SNP variant quality score recalibration model. Should be supplied in the same order as the resource labels. E.g. ['/absolute/path/to/7g8_gb4.combined.final.vcf.gz','/absolute/path/to/hb3_dd2.combined.final.vcf.gz','/absolute/path/to/3d7_hb3.combined.final.vcf.gz',]

vqsr_snp_resource_labels.description: Resource labels for SNP VQSR training files.
vqsr_snp_resource_labels.help_text: Array of GATK resource specifications for each SNP training VCF. Should be supplied in the same order as the resource VCFs. Format: '--resource:name,known=false,training=true,truth=true,prior=15.0'

vqsr_snp_annotations.description: Annotations to use for SNP VQSR model training.
vqsr_snp_annotations.help_text: Variant annotations to use for building the SNP VQSR model. To be supplied as copmlete GATK CLI arguments (e.g., '-an QD -an FS -an SOR').

vqsr_snp_tranches.help_text: Space-separated list of sensitivity tranches for the SNP VQSR model.

vqsr_indel_resource_vcfs.description: List of VCF files to use as training resources for INDEL VQSR.
vqsr_indel_resource_vcfs.help_text: Array of paths to high-confidence VCF files used for training the INDEL variant quality score recalibration model. Should be supplied in the same order as the resource labels.

vqsr_indel_resource_labels.description: Resource labels for INDEL VQSR training files.
vqsr_indel_resource_labels.help_text: Array of GATK resource specifications for each INDEL training VCF. Should be supplied in the same order as the resource VCFs. Format: '--resource:name,known=false,training=true,truth=true,prior=15.0'

vqsr_indel_annotations.description: Annotations to use for INDEL VQSR model training.
vqsr_indel_annotations.help_text: Variant annotations to use for building the INDEL VQSR model. To be supplied as complete GATK CLI arguments (e.g., '-an QD -an FS -an SOR').

vqsr_indel_tranches.help_text: Space-separated list of sensitivity tranches for the INDEL VQSR model.

annotation.title: Annotation options
annotation.description: Configure snpEff for annotation of variants.

reference_annotation.description: Path to gene annotation file (gff3/gtf) used for building the snpEff database.
reference_annotation.errorMessage: Input must be a .gff, .gff3, or .gtf file (optionally gzipped).

reference_cds.description: Path to CDS FASTA file to use as a check during the snpEff database building step.
reference_cds.errorMessage: Input must be a .fna or .fasta file (optionally gzipped).

reference_protein.description: Path to protein FASTA file to use as a check during the snpEff database building step.
reference_protein.errorMessage: Input must be a .fna or .fasta file (optionally gzipped).

annotation_format.description: Type of annotation file (gff or gtf).
annotation_format.help: When omitted, the file type will be detected automatically from the file extension (if it is set correctly).

save_snpeff_db.description: Save snpEff database of the reference genome.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
